body.prose:
What the day of 2026-11-04 did not settle, each to be weighed when the work reaches it:

- **What makes a whole a dimension**, answered on 2026-11-05 as the brief's own schema, as [knowledge](ref:01M6MFK1NEXXHDC30PG2Q8JAW2) tells; how far its mark reaches is open.
- **How briefs hold their parts, and prose made native**, proposed in [knowledge](ref:01M6MFK1NED7AGTYGQ7VVGAGAK).
- **A single owner**, left open on purpose, as [above](ref:01M6M9PESETZQR3N9K80045R1Q).
- **Whether a mount holds what it offers**, and how the offer's names stand beside the names holons carry.
- **How a bare name is found.**
- **Lifetime**: whether a holon nothing holds should ever leave the field on its own. Set aside.

*The author's, 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05.*
body.title: What is open
